summary: End-to-end validation of HORMOscope paywall + Journal lock changes. Both backend (pytest, 4/4 passed) and frontend (Playwright, mobile 390x844) verified the full flow: fresh signup → journal locked (no free counter) → POST /api/journal returns 402 → PayPal buttons present with correct plan IDs → manual-unlock flips is_premium → journal becomes writable → POST /api/journal returns 200. No 'AI' wording on either page; all h1/h2/h3 headings on /pro and /journal use Poiret One.
critical_code_review_comments: ProPage.js handleManualUnlock immediately calls window.location.href='/' after refreshCustomerInfo() — works but does a full reload. Acceptable for now, but a SPA navigate() would feel snappier.
RevenueCat 60s purchase timeout uses alert() (line 157) — fine, but blocks the UI; consider a toast.
JournalPage.js fetchEntries runs even for non-Pro users on mount (before the !isPro guard), causing one extra GET /api/journal call per load. Harmless (endpoint is auth-only), but wasted call.
Onboarding endpoint requires `birthday` field; that is not documented in the review request payload spec — surfaced during test (added to fixture).
test_credentials: Fresh user created per test run: qa_<unix_ts>@test.com / TestPass123! (signup + onboarding via API including birthday:'1995-06-15').
seed_data_creation: Each backend test run signs up a fresh qa_<ts>@test.com user. No cleanup performed (test users are isolated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_paywall_journal_lock.py covers: signup, onboarding (needs birthday field), /auth/me, /api/journal 402, /api/premium/manual-unlock, /api/journal 200 after unlock. Playwright UI test confirms: data-testid='journal-locked' + 'journal-locked-cta' on free-user /journal, no 'journal-free-counter' element, PayPal buttons (paypal-yearly-btn / paypal-monthly-btn) with correct plan IDs P-380677633N8816939NITG3LI (yearly) and P-52W662450M0497419NITGTGY (monthly) opening in target=_blank, manual-unlock-btn with confirm() dialog, restore-btn clickable. After unlock, journal-page (writable) renders. All h1/h2/h3 headings on /pro and /journal computed-style is 'Poiret One', cursive. No whole-word 'AI' matches on either page.
